text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ... Ugh, uuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying not to get too excited. 'Cause 
I'll end up getting carried away right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm just so excited to run! I can't 
hold back the hype~!
choice_data_list: You don't have to hold back.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Still, if I don't take this 
seriously...
choice_data_list: Urara is definitely taking it seriously.

text_block_list.text:
Even if she doesn't understand what it 
means to be serious, she's worrying that 
"I need to get serious." For the current 
Haru Urara, that alone is enough.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? I'm being serious!? What do you mean 
by that~!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Really? All right, I'm off then!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Folk
text_block_list.text: Heeey, Urara-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh, everyone! Did you all come to cheer 
for me?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, this is Hokkaido!?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
I'd go to Hokkaido or anywhere else! If 
it's for Urala-chan's sake!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chan, we're sorry! We were wrong all 
along!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text:
All they ever say is that they're happy as 
long as Urara-chan is running...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text:
I never really believed in Urara-chan. I 
wasn't genuinely cheering for her back 
then.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text: —But it's different now! Urara-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text: Win, you better win!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Don't lose, Urara-chan! You're carrying 
all our dreams on your shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Show us what it looks like when you win, 
Urara-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! I'm gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, I'm getting goosebumps all over! 
But it doesn't feel bad at all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I... I won't lose to anyone! So make sure 
you watch me!
